look_here_first: Start with the smooth leathery mature capsule and flower structure: stamens are usually included or barely extend beyond the tubular petals. Opposite palmately compound leaves confirm buckeye but not species; yellow-flowered var. flavescens means red color is not a universal species key.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Deciduous shrub to small tree, sometimes multistemmed.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, palmately compound with usually 5 (sometimes 7) serrate leaflets; leaf count overlaps A. glabra.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Terminal panicles with relatively tubular unequal petals; stamens included to slightly exserted, approximately petal length. Typical flowers red, but accepted var. flavescens can be yellow.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: Smooth, rounded leathery capsule usually lacking the short prickles typical of A. glabra; large shiny brown seeds.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stamens included or only slightly beyond petals

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: tubular flower profile and unequal petals
